d:
The Knicks defeated the Nets, 103-90 tonight in New York. Landry Shamet finished with a team-high 22 points along with 4 three pointers for the Knicks, while Jalen Brunson tallied 19 points, 6 assists and 4 three pointers in the game. Julius Randle recorded 21 points, 11 rebounds and 2 assists. The Knicks improve their record to 3-4 with the win, while the Nets fall to 1-6 for the season.
